summary: Story search and single-story detail are live calls to Digg's public search endpoint, covering every topic Digg currently lists, with no local search copy; the ranked feed is read live per topic; sync only snapshots ranked lists for rank history; and a view Digg stops serving is removed from the CLI, MCP tools and docs instead of returning empty data with a success exit. A Digg response missing the list a command reads is an error, not an empty result; a source list Digg cut short is reported as incomplete; and `watch` compares each poll with the same topic's previous poll, whatever else shares the store.
reason: Digg's surface keeps moving (endpoints, tool names, topics and result fields), so a local copy of the feed goes stale and hides outages as empty results, which zeroed out downstream research tools. The id write search makes for later short-id lookups must stay best-effort and time-bounded so it never changes search results or the exit code.
validated_outcome: TestSearchConcurrentProcessesShareOneStore runs separate search processes against one store; TestSearchUnwritableStoreStillReturnsResults shows a failed id write leaves results and exit code alone; TestSearchServerErrorIsNotAnEmptyResult and TestPostsDiggErrorIsNotAnEmptyResult show a failed call exits non-zero; TestCommandsDiggNoLongerFeedsAreRemoved and TestRegisterToolsOmitsRemovedCommands pin the removals; doctor reports the search endpoint as its own check; TestSearchRejectsAResponseWithoutAPostsArray and TestPostsAndStoryRejectAResponseWithoutStoryOrSources pin the shape checks; TestWatchTopicsSharingAStoreKeepTheirOwnBaseline pins the per-topic baseline.
